decision: Exclude the unreferenced KEYB shared-data definitions from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The header identifies the structures as shared between resident and transient KEYB code.
No include of keybshar.inc was found in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
limitations: Exclusion covers the selected three-component build only; KEYB itself is not part of the reconstruction scope.
